# Systemia Decision Lab

Product key: systemia-decision-lab
Canonical product: https://systemiadecisionlab.base44.app/
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/systemia-decision-lab/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/systemia-decision-lab/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- should I hire an employee
- hire vs outsource
- hire vs automate
- should I promote or restructure instead of hiring
- what role actually solves this business problem
- compare the real cost of hiring before adding payroll

## Authority

public owner-side workforce decision analysis; the free decision report structures alternatives while human judgment remains final

## Commercial state

- Status: source_checkout_wired_live_verification_pending
- Offer: Decision Report · Free
- Offer: Hiring Action Pack · $49 one-time
- Payment state: Source includes Stripe checkout and confirmation functions; paid state must be independently provider-verified before fulfillment

## Boundaries

- does not rank job candidates or make employment decisions
- does not replace lawful human review of applicants or employees
- a decision report is planning support rather than a legal or HR determination
- paid fulfillment requires provider-verified payment; checkout creation alone is not payment proof

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
